text: Holland...In 129, the decimal system of France was introu- ted, but with the old Dutch manufacture, be explained under the Kingdom. Of the old weights still used in any place, 10240 as a 320 engels = 16 oz. = 2 marks a Dutch lie; try to 114911 a revolves. There are also 100 in the commercial lb, a 10083 lb, avvol, and 100 commercial ls. = 1 centner. And Amsterdam has a11296, and the Bernabat or Bellen includes a th296, and the Bernabat els = 277.8 Brit. inches. Nineteen Dutch legases make one degree of the menates.
